site.name: Ibex / Little Jonny Mine
site.componentDetail: Little Jonny (Ibex No. 1) gold mine within the Ibex Mining Company complex on Breece Hill
overview: The Little Jonny was a major gold-producing working within the broader Ibex property on Breece Hill in the Leadville district.
Remnant preserves the relationship between the Little Jonny working and the Ibex property while keeping the individual mine component identifiable.

timeline.text: Major development expanded the Ibex / Little Jonny workings during Leadville’s later gold-producing period.
Federal and mining-history sources document substantial gold production from the Ibex / Little Jonny operation during this period.
Historical records document a Denver & Rio Grande railroad connection serving the Ibex operation.
The property remained part of the heavily developed Breece Hill mining landscape.

moreHistory: Mining-history sources identify the Little Jonny as Ibex No. 1 and a significant gold-development component of the Ibex property.
The property is associated with J.J. Brown management in the broader historical record, linking the industrial history of Breece Hill with well-known Leadville personalities.
The railroad connection illustrates how large mine properties depended on transportation infrastructure for ore, supplies, and equipment.

production.summary: Historical sources describe substantial gold production from the Ibex / Little Jonny operation. Exact totals should remain tied to the specific source and period that reported them.

commodities.name: Gold
commodities.period: Major production documented during the 1890s and early 1900s

production.note: Remnant avoids presenting an unsupported lifetime production total.
